moments.title: There is a different rate of inflation for every industry
moments.summary: The facilitator explains that the headline inflation number is not one number: India runs at roughly 5-6% across the country, but individual industries experience their own rates.
moments.evidence: interesting thing is there is a different rate of inflation for every industry or sector. So currently India experiences about a 5-6% inflation rate and that is across the country but different industries they have they experience different inflation rates.

moments.title: Medical inflation is 14-15%, compounding every year
moments.summary: The concrete example: medical inflation runs at 14-15%, which means medical bills rise by that much every year on a compounded basis.
moments.evidence: So for example medical inflation today is 14-15% so that means every year our medical bills are going to increase by 14-15% on a compounded basis.
